Paragraph: "You shall know whether those two are clean at heart or otherwise, or about their evil-mindedness or otherwise by conversation..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Determining moral character and underlying motives.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva instructs Hanuma to use verbal cues and dialogic probing to discern purity vs. evil intent.
Outcome/Resolution: He trusts dialogue as the ultimate test of internal character.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Parikshana (Systematic examination of character and moral intent)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: True spiritual character is revealed through authentic speech and purity of heart (Shuddhi).
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Discernment: analyzing verbal content and tone to judge the safety and integrity of potential allies.
